input.draft: Users sign in with email and password. The server returns a session token that stays valid until the user signs out.
The search endpoint returns every matching record in one response.
The export button downloads the current table as a CSV file. The file name is the table name plus the date. Rows keep the on-screen order. An empty table downloads a file with only the header row.
When a webhook delivery fails, retry immediately until it succeeds.
The dashboard should load fast and look modern.
Users can upload a profile photo. The photo is shown on their profile page.
Orders over 100 dollars ship free. All orders pay a flat shipping fee of 5 dollars.
A user can rename a project from its settings page. Names are 1 to 60 characters. Saving an empty or too long name shows an inline error and keeps the old name.
